description: Shoppable looks: the clothes in stock that match each piece of one of our outfit looks. Call without arguments to list the looks and their pieces, with look to see a look's pieces, and with look and piece to get the matching products.

country.description: Two-letter shopping country, e.g. se, no, gb, us.

look.description: A look slug from this tool.

piece.description: A piece of that look, e.g. top.

name: outfit_pieces
title: Pieces of a look
